text: You're looking for a dish that's quick, satisfying, and won't blow your calorie budget. This Macaroni & Tomatoes recipe fits the bill perfectly. With a cooking time of just 20 minutes, you can have a delicious, creamy pasta dish on the table in no time. The combination of diced tomatoes, parmesan cheese, and macaroni is a classic for a reason - it's a match made in heaven. Plus, at only 184 calories per serving, you can enjoy this dish without feeling guilty about your health goals. Give it a try!
